data.narrative:
Lucid Bots is a Series B robotics and manufacturing company that has raised $36.4M to date. The valuation analysis draws on a peer set of 3 same-stage, same-sector private companies (Generalist AI, Bedrock Robotics, and Dexterity) valued between $1.6B and $2.0B, alongside 1 public comparable and 8 additional private peers in the robotics sector.

Two triangulation methods are applicable. The stage-progression method applies a 1.9x step-up multiplier typical of Series B advancement to the $36M raised proxy, implying a valuation of $69M. The peer-median method benchmarks Lucid Bots against the three same-stage robotics comparables, which have a median valuation of $1.8B and a range of $1.6B to $2.0B, directly implying $1.8B.

The wide dispersion between methods reflects fundamental uncertainty in the startup's current traction and competitive position relative to benchmarks. The stage-progression approach assumes capital raised approximates value creation; the peer-median approach assumes Lucid Bots merits parity with named competitors. A triangulated range of $59M (low) to $2.0B (high) brackets plausible outcomes, with a median of $910M. Resolution of key uncertainties—including revenue run-rate, customer concentration, and technical differentiation versus Bedrock Robotics and Dexterity—would narrow this considerably.
